search_appetite.description: Search Google for appetite-related content (restaurants, recipes, nutrition) and extract enriched results including optional rating, cook time, and calorie data.

query.description: Search query, e.g. 'pasta carbonara', 'Italian restaurants Chicago', 'avocado nutrition'.

type.description: Optional category hint to qualify the query: 'restaurant', 'recipe', 'nutrition', 'herbs-and-spices', 'rice', 'potatoes', or 'sausage'. Omit for a plain search.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of organic results to return (default 10, max 50).

returns.description: Array of result objects with title, url, snippet, and optional rating, cookTime, calories fields.

search_and_extract.description: Perform a Google search and extract top organic results.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to extract.

get_autocomplete_suggestions.description: Get autocomplete suggestions for the current search query.
